extracted.name: Lobster Dip
extracted.description: Lobster appetizers are a must at any party, and with rich lobster, cream cheese, and horseradish for some heat, this exciting dip is always a hit!
ingredient_lines: 1 (7 ounce) can lobster meat, drained and flaked
instruction_lines: Mix cream cheese, lobster meat, butter, horseradish, onion, and lemon juice together in a bowl until smooth. Cover and chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
